home.intro: Short practice rounds for reading, math, science, and French. Pick a grade, choose a topic, and work through shuffled cards at your own pace.

default.title: Practice
default.listenCue: Listen, then pick what you hear
default.choiceFinished: Nice studying. Head home when you want another round.
default.typingFinished: Amazing reading practice. Want another round? Head home and start again.

subjects.blurb: Hear a word, then find it among look-alikes.

subjects.subject: reading
subjects.summary: Sight words out loud or typed, and words to spell by ear.

decks.title: Speech & Typing
decks.description: Practice high-frequency words aloud or by typing. Cards shuffle each round; with the mic, pause briefly after each word.

decks.title: Vocabulary
decks.description: Listen to a word read aloud, then tap that word among look-alikes. Tap Play again to hear it once more. {count} words.

decks.title: Addition Facts
decks.description: Quick sums under ten. Say the answer or type it — digits like “7” or words like “seven” both work when using voice.

subjects.subject: math
subjects.summary: Multi-digit multiplication, long division, fractions, decimals, and order of operations.
subjects.blurb: Multi-digit multiplication, long division, fractions, decimals, and order of operations.

decks.title: Multi-Digit Multiplication
decks.description: 2- and 3-digit numbers times 2-digit numbers, plus 4-digit times 1-digit.

decks.title: Long Division
decks.description: Up to 4-digit dividends and 2-digit divisors, some with remainders.

decks.title: Fractions
decks.description: Add and subtract with unlike denominators, and multiply fractions.

decks.title: Decimals
decks.description: Add and subtract to hundredths, multiply by whole numbers, and × or ÷ by 10, 100, and 1,000.

decks.title: Mixed Review
decks.description: A mix of every 5th grade topic.

subjects.subject: math
subjects.summary: Decimal operations, with more units coming.
subjects.blurb: Ten units for the year, starting with Decimal Operations.

deck.description: Add, subtract, multiply, and divide decimals — including money and measurement.

subjects.subject: science
subjects.summary: Cells, human body, genetics, evolution, and environment.
subjects.blurb: Cells, the human body, genetics, evolution, and environmental science.

deck.description: The basic unit of life, cell parts, and what each part does.
Body systems and the organs that keep them running.
DNA, dominant and recessive traits, genotype vs. phenotype, and Punnett squares.
Natural selection, adaptations, fossils, and extinction.
Ecosystems, producers, food chains, resources, and pollution.

subjects.subject: french
subjects.summary: The alphabet and color words, with more units coming.
subjects.blurb: Alphabet, communication, colors, food, and school, starting with the Alphabet.

deck.description: Hear a letter said in French, then pick it, accents included. {count} letters.
Twelve color words — French to English, English to French, and short example phrases.

subjects.blurb: Countries of the world on the map, one region per unit.

cards.question: What is the basic unit of life?
Which structure controls what enters and leaves the cell?
What part of the cell contains DNA?
Which structure is found only in plant cells?
What is the job of mitochondria?
Which system carries oxygen and nutrients through the body?
What organ is the main control center of the body?
What is the main function of the skeletal system?
Which organ pumps blood throughout the body?
A trait that shows up even if only one copy is present is called…
What tool shows possible genetic outcomes?
What is natural selection?
cards.answer: Survival of organisms best suited to the environment

cards.answer: A community of living and nonliving things

cards.question: How do you say "red" in French?
cards.hint: It starts with "r": un ballon ___ (a red ball).

cards.question: What does "rouge" mean?
cards.hint: You'd see it in "un ballon rouge".

cards.question: What does "un ballon rouge" mean?
cards.hint: The color word is "rouge".

cards.question: How do you say "blue" in French?
cards.hint: It starts with "b": le ciel est ___ (the sky is blue).

cards.question: What does "bleu" mean?
cards.hint: You'd see it in "le ciel est bleu".

cards.question: What does "le ciel est bleu" mean?
cards.hint: The color word is "bleu".

cards.question: How do you say "green" in French?
cards.hint: It starts with "v": une feuille ___ (a green leaf).

cards.question: What does "vert" mean?
cards.hint: You'd see it in "une feuille verte".

cards.question: What does "une feuille verte" mean?
cards.hint: "verte" is "vert" + e because "feuille" is feminine.

cards.question: How do you say "yellow" in French?
cards.hint: It starts with "j": un soleil ___ (a yellow sun).

cards.question: What does "jaune" mean?
cards.hint: You'd see it in "un soleil jaune".

cards.question: What does "un soleil jaune" mean?
cards.hint: The color word is "jaune".

cards.question: How do you say "black" in French?
cards.hint: It starts with "n": un chat ___ (a black cat).

cards.question: What does "noir" mean?
cards.hint: You'd see it in "un chat noir".

cards.question: What does "un chat noir" mean?
cards.hint: The color word is "noir".

cards.question: How do you say "white" in French?
cards.hint: It starts with "b": une chemise ___ (a white shirt).

cards.question: What does "blanc" mean?
cards.hint: You'd see it in "une chemise blanche".

cards.question: What does "une chemise blanche" mean?
cards.hint: "blanche" is the feminine form of "blanc" because "chemise" is feminine.

cards.question: How do you say "brown" in French?
cards.hint: It starts with "m": un café ___ (a brown coffee).

cards.question: What does "marron" mean?
cards.hint: You'd see it in "un café marron".

cards.question: What does "un café marron" mean?
cards.hint: The color word is "marron".

cards.question: How do you say "gray" in French?
cards.hint: It starts with "g": un ciel ___ (a gray sky).

cards.question: What does "gris" mean?
cards.hint: You'd see it in "un ciel gris".

cards.question: What does "un ciel gris" mean?
cards.hint: The color word is "gris".

cards.question: How do you say "orange" in French?
cards.hint: It starts with "o": une ___ (an orange fruit).

cards.question: What does "orange" mean?
cards.hint: You'd see it in "une orange".

cards.question: What does "une orange" mean?
cards.hint: Here "orange" is the fruit itself — same word as the color.

cards.question: How do you say "pink" in French?
cards.hint: It starts with "r": une fleur ___ (a pink flower).

cards.question: What does "rose" mean?
cards.hint: You'd see it in "une fleur rose".

cards.question: What does "une fleur rose" mean?
cards.hint: The color word is "rose".

cards.question: How do you say "purple" in French?
cards.hint: It starts with "v": des fleurs ___ (purple flowers).

cards.question: What does "violet" mean?
cards.hint: You'd see it in "des fleurs violettes".

cards.question: What does "des fleurs violettes" mean?
cards.hint: "violettes" is "violet" made feminine and plural to match "fleurs".

cards.question: How do you say "beige" in French?
cards.hint: It starts with "b": un canapé ___ (a beige sofa).

cards.question: What does "beige" mean?
cards.hint: You'd see it in "un canapé beige".

cards.question: What does "un canapé beige" mean?
cards.hint: The color word is "beige".
